caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
positive_analysis:
The car's front bumper collides with the brick wall surface.
The impact force deforms the car's front end and shatters the wall bricks.
The wall's structural resistance abruptly stops the car's forward motion.
The car comes to rest with its crumpled front embedded in the wall.

The car's rear section intersects with the hole in the brick wall.
If the car moves forward, its rear will emerge from the wall's opening.
If the car reverses, its body will retreat deeper into the wall cavity.
The car's front wheels and bumper rest on the paved street surface.
